recipes.name: Butter chicken (chicken makhani)
ing: ½ kg (1.1 lbs) boneless chicken, cut to 1-inch pieces
½ to ¾ tsp Kashmiri red chili powder (or paprika) + 1 to 2 tsp Kashmiri chili powder
¾ to 1 tbsp lemon juice (1 lemon ≈ 3 tbsp)
¾ tbsp ginger garlic paste (ginger half) + ¾ tbsp ginger garlic paste, sauce (ginger half)
¾ tbsp ginger garlic paste (garlic half, ≈1 clove) + ¾ tbsp ginger garlic paste, sauce (garlic half, ≈1 clove)
¾ to 1 tsp garam masala + 1 to 1½ tsp garam masala
½ tsp cumin powder (optional) + ½ tsp cumin powder (optional)
1 tsp coriander powder (optional) + 1 to 1½ tsp coriander powder (optional)
1 tsp kasuri methi (optional) + ½ tbsp kasuri methi
28 (42 g, ⅓ cup) whole raw cashews
⅓ cup (80 to 100 ml) heavy cream

recipes.name: Seco de pollo (Ecuadorian chicken stew)
ing: 4 to 5 lbs of assorted chicken pieces
2 tsp ground achiote or annatto (can also use paprika)
1 to 2 cups of beer or chicken broth
1 cup of naranjilla/lulo juice (or fresh orange juice; about 3 oranges) + Juice of 1 orange (optional)
Optional: 1 aji or hot pepper (jalapeño or serrano)

recipes.name: Locro de papa (Ecuadorian potato cheese soup)
ing: 10 medium sized potatoes, peeled and chopped
1 cup grated or crumbled cheese (quesillo, queso fresco, mozzarella or Monterey Jack) + To serve: 1 cup of queso fresco, feta or grated mozzarella
1 bunch of cilantro, leaves only, minced
To serve: avocados, sliced or diced
To serve: chopped cilantro and green onions

recipes.name: Llapingachos (Ecuadorian cheese-stuffed potato patties)
ing: 5 large Russet potatoes, about 3 lbs (makes 12 patties; 2 per person)
½ cup finely chopped white onion
1 cup grated quesillo or mozzarella cheese

recipes.name: Easy red chicken enchiladas
ing: 1 ½ cups cooked shredded chicken (about 0.6 lb raw)
2 cups enchilada sauce, divided (store-bought is fine)
2 ½ cups shredded Mexican-blend cheese, divided

recipes.name: Mexican pork carnitas
ing: 4-5 pounds pork shoulder, cut into large pieces (slow cooker, or Dutch oven at 325°F for 4 hrs)

recipes.name: Shrimp and grits
ing: ⅓ cup diced green or red bell pepper
1 pound medium shrimp, peeled and deveined
½ teaspoon garlic powder (shrimp) + ½ teaspoon garlic powder (grits)

recipes.name: Southern baked mac and cheese
ing: 5 tablespoons salted butter + Topping: 2 teaspoons butter, melted
½ cup half and half or light cream
14 ounces shredded sharp cheddar cheese + Topping: 2 ounces shredded sharp cheddar cheese
1½ ounces shredded Parmesan cheese + Topping: 2 tablespoons shredded Parmesan cheese
Topping: ¼ cup Panko bread crumbs

recipes.name: Southern smothered pork chops
ing: 1 medium white onion, sliced into half moons

recipes.name: Chana masala (chickpea curry)
ing: ¾ to 1 tablespoon ginger garlic paste (ginger half)
¾ to 1 tablespoon ginger garlic paste (garlic half)
1½ teaspoons Kashmiri red chili powder (or paprika)

recipes.name: Chicken tikka masala
ing: Marinade: ½ to 1 tsp Kashmiri red chili powder (or paprika) + Masala: ½ to 1 tsp Kashmiri red chili powder (or paprika)
Marinade: 1 teaspoon garam masala + Masala: 2 teaspoons garam masala
Marinade: 1 teaspoon coriander powder + Masala: 1 tablespoon coriander powder
Marinade: ½ teaspoon cumin powder + Masala: 1 to 1½ teaspoon cumin powder
Marinade: 1 tablespoon kasuri methi + Masala: ½ tablespoon kasuri methi
Marinade: 1 tablespoon ginger garlic paste (ginger half) + Masala: 1 tablespoon ginger garlic paste (ginger half)
Marinade: 1 tablespoon ginger garlic paste (garlic half) + Masala: 1 tablespoon ginger garlic paste (garlic half)
Marinade: 1 tablespoon oil + Masala: 3 tablespoons oil (or ghee)
Masala: 1½ cups (180 g) onions, fine chopped
Masala: ½ cup heavy cream + Garnish: 3 tablespoons heavy cream

recipes.name: Aloo gobi (potato cauliflower curry)
ing: ¾ to 1 cup (1 medium) onion, chopped finely
¾ to 1 cup (2 medium) tomatoes, finely chopped
½ tablespoon ginger, minced or grated
½ tablespoon (3 to 4) garlic cloves, minced
½ teaspoon cumin seeds (ground cumin works) + ½ to ¾ teaspoon roasted cumin powder
¾ to 1¼ teaspoon Kashmiri red chili powder (or paprika)
1 tablespoon kasuri methi (skip if you don't have)

recipes.name: Chicken chow mein
ing: 200g / 6 oz chicken breast or thigh, thinly sliced
1 1/2 tbsp peanut oil (or other cooking oil)
Sauce: 1 1/2 tbsp Chinese cooking wine OR mirin
Sauce: 2 tsp sugar (reduce to 1 tsp if using mirin)

recipes.name: Oyakodon (Japanese chicken and egg rice bowl)
ing: 1 Tbsp sake (or dry sherry, or omit)
½ cup dashi (made from dashi powder or a packet)
2 servings cooked short-grain rice (about 1 cup dry)

recipes.name: Korean beef bowl
